business_problem: Walmart wanted to reduce shopping friction by helping customers find products, understand features, compare options, and plan purchases for specific occasions without guesswork.
solution_summary: Walmart introduced Sparky as a generative AI shopping assistant embedded directly in the Walmart app, where customers access it through the “Ask Sparky” button. Ingest begins with natural-language customer requests about products, occasions, or shopping tasks. Sparky processes those prompts against Walmart commerce content that the article explicitly names, including product questions, product descriptions, product comparisons, and synthesized product reviews, then serves back instant answers and recommendations within the same shopping experience. The assistant supports discovery, comparison, and occasion-based planning so shoppers can move from question to product selection and cart action without leaving the app flow. The source does not name external vendors, models, or backend storage services, but it clearly shows Sparky as the conversational serving layer packaging Walmart’s retail data and existing AI shopping features into a personalized digital shopping companion.
